title: Four in a Line - Terminal Game Development
instructions: Build a complete "Four in a Line" (Connect Four) game running in terminal. Implement board display, player input, win detection, AI opponent, and game state persistence. Use Python with clean architecture and modular design.

1783287585.53438.instruction: Create project directory structure (four_in_line/) with main modules: board.py, game.py, player.py, ai.py, main.py. Implement Board class with 7 columns x 6 rows grid. Include methods: display() for terminal rendering with unicode box-drawing characters, drop_piece(column, player), is_valid_move(column), and board initialization. Test board display with empty and partially filled states.

1783287585.535733.instruction: Implement win detection in Board class. Check four consecutive pieces in: horizontal (rows), vertical (columns), diagonal (both directions). Methods: check_win(player) returning boolean, get_winning_positions() returning coordinates. Test with predefined board states: horizontal win, vertical win, diagonal wins (both slopes), no win, near-win scenarios. Optimize for efficiency - stop checking when impossible to win.

1783287585.535959.instruction: Create Player class handling human input. Features: get_move(board) prompting for column (1-7), input validation (numeric, in range, column not full), error messages with re-prompt, optional quit command ('q'). Implement move history tracking. Test edge cases: non-numeric input, out of range, full column, valid moves.

1783287585.5363498.instruction: Build Game class orchestrating gameplay. Features: initialize with two players (human/AI), main loop (display board → get move → apply move → check win → switch player), game state (active, win, draw), turn indicator, move counter. Handle draw condition (board full). Display game result with winning line highlight. Test complete game flows.

1783287585.536595.instruction: Create AI class with multiple difficulty levels. Easy: random valid moves. Medium: block opponent wins, take winning moves, prefer center columns. Hard: minimax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning, depth-limited search (3-5 levels), position evaluation function (center control, threats). Test AI vs AI games for balance.

1783287585.5368135.instruction: Implement game persistence using JSON. Features: save_game(filename) storing board state, current player, move history; load_game(filename) restoring state; list_saved_games(); auto-save on exit option. Handle corrupted save files gracefully. Test save/load cycles, file I/O errors.

1783287585.536944.instruction: Enhance visual presentation. Features: colored output (red/yellow pieces using ANSI codes), clear screen between turns, column headers (1-7), piece drop animation option, score tracking (best of series), main menu (new game, load game, instructions, quit). Ensure cross-platform compatibility (Windows/Unix).

1783287585.5370665.instruction: Final integration testing. Run complete games: human vs human, human vs AI (all levels), AI vs AI. Verify all win conditions trigger correctly. Test save/load during active game. Confirm proper error handling throughout. Document gameplay instructions in README.md. Final code review for clarity and Python best practices.
